newsitem.title: CHINA: China to renovate Forbidden City of emperors.
newsitem.headline: China to renovate Forbidden City of emperors.

text.p: China's capital Beijing is to spend millions of dollars renovating the Forbidden City, the palace home of China's former emperors, to greet the 21st century, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
China will spend 200 million yuan ($24 million) on the huge renovation of the sprawling compound of courtyards and buildings topped by roofing in imperial yellow, Xinhua said.

The project would include dredging the moat surrounding the imperial complex, blocking all 480 sewage outlets along the waterway and relocating people living around the compound in the heart of Beijing, it said.
Renovation of the Forbidden City, which faces Beijing's Tiananmen Square, would be finished by 2000, it said.
